messages:
Maya: Hey team, just started today. The ethernet dongle included in my kit isn't recognized by my Windows laptop (shows as Unknown USB Device). Tried two USB ports. Anyone seen this?

zack_it: Welcome Maya! Can you check Device Manager -> Network adapters and paste the exact entry name? Also try `pnputil /enum-devices /connected` in PowerShell and paste the adapter block.

Maya: Device Manager shows "Unknown USB Device (Device Descriptor Request Failed)". Ran pnputil but not sure which block is the dongle.

it-bot: New IT ticket created: #45211 - "New hire ethernet dongle enumerates as unknown device" assigned to zack_it.

zack_it: Thanks. Two quick checks: 1) power cycle the laptop and remove all USB hubs, plug dongle directly; 2) if that fails, try the dongle on another machine (IT spare or home desktop) to rule out dongle failure. If it's still Unknown, we'll ship replacement.

Maya: Plugged direct and rebooted, still Unknown. Tried on a personal PC and it enumerated fine as "ASIX AX88179 USB 3.0 to Gigabit Ethernet". So laptop side seems picky.

zack_it: Good repro. Likely driver signature or USB suspend issue. On your work laptop run (Admin PowerShell): `pnputil /add-driver C:\Drivers\ASIX\ax88179.inf /install` — we host the driver in our assets. If that fails, disable USB selective suspend: Control Panel -> Power Options -> Change plan settings -> Advanced -> USB settings -> USB selective suspend = Disabled.

Maya: I don't have the driver on the machine yet. Can you push it?

zack_it: I'll push via Intune. If Intune agent hasn't checked in yet, try manual install after I upload. ETA 15 minutes. Also tagging @anna-facilities to include a return label in case we need the dongle back.

anna-facilities: Noted. If replacement required we'll include prepaid return.

it-bot: Ticket #45211 status updated: pending_action -> awaiting_intune_deploy.

Maya: Intune pushed the driver, installed cleanly, ethernet showed up as "Ethernet 2" and connected. Upload speed looks good. Thank you!

zack_it: Awesome. Leave the dongle plugged in for a day and LMK if it disconnects. If it flaps, we'll swap hardware. Enjoy the first day :) :tada:
